name: Video Gallery for YouTube – turn your channel into a stunning gallery
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Turn your YouTube channel or playlists into a beautiful, customizable video gallery on your WordPress site – no coding required.

Demos | Documentation

Why Video Gallery for YouTube?

Embedding videos one by one is slow, and single embeds don’t show off a channel. Video Gallery for YouTube lets you display your entire YouTube channel or playlist as a visually stunning gallery, seamlessly integrated with Gutenberg through an intuitive block interface.

Choose from three layout types, configure the player, and control exactly which video information appears – title, views, likes, comments, and date. Combine different layouts to create an engaging multimedia experience that keeps your audience watching, and it all stays responsive on mobile and tablet devices.

Free Features

  • Channel or Playlist Source: Display YouTube channel or playlist videos anywhere on your site.
  • Three Layout Types: Default, Grid Details, and Playlists.
  • Video Sorting: Filter videos by order – Date, Title, or Rating.
  • Videos Per Page: Set how many videos display at once, with a load more button.
  • Grid Controls: Configure columns and adjust column and row gaps.
  • Player Options: Customize player height and toggle player controls, post-playback channel suggestions, video logo, and fullscreen icon.
  • Video Info Show/Hide: Toggle Title, Views, Likes, Comments, and Date per video.
  • Title Controls: Define title text length, redirect by clicking the title, and customize title typography and color.
  • Styling Options: Set cover image border radius and adjust video info size and color.
  • Responsive Design: Galleries perform seamlessly on mobile and tablet devices.

How to Use – Quick Start

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open the page or post where you want to show the gallery.
  3. Click the + button in the Gutenberg editor and search for Video Gallery For YouTube.
  4. Select the block, set up your gallery, then customize the view from the right sidebar.
  5. Publish the page. Enjoy!

For installation help, see the Installation tab.

Use Cases

  • YouTubers & content creators: Showcase your channel and grow watch time from your own site.
  • Course creators & educational sites: Organize lesson videos in clean playlist layouts.
  • Business & portfolio sites: Present product demos, testimonials, and media coverage.
  • Marketers & influencers: Keep landing pages fresh with your latest video content.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Video Gallery for YouTube”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. In the block editor, search for the Video Gallery For YouTube block and add it to any page or post.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the video-gallery-for-youtube plugin (.zip file).
  2. In your admin area, go to Plugins → Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the video-gallery-for-youtube.zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin – or upload the extracted folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate from the Plugins menu.
sections.faq:
Is Video Gallery For YouTube free?

Yes, Video Gallery For YouTube is a free Gutenberg block plugin.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I display an entire YouTube channel or playlist?

Yes. You can display videos from a YouTube channel or a playlist, and sort them by Date, Title, or Rating.

What layouts are available?

There are three layout types: Default, Grid Details, and Playlists. You can also configure columns and adjust column and row gaps.

Can I hide video details like views or likes?

Yes. You can show or hide the Title, Views, Likes, Comments, and Date for each video, and control the title text length.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change all block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse the block?

You can use it unlimited times across your site.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here.
